# Pet test photos

Two dogs and two cats, used by the tagging and search tests (`src/clip/fixture_tests.rs`): a dog
must be tagged and found as a dog and never as a cat, and the reverse. Each licence was checked on
the file's Wikimedia Commons page on 2026-11-18, in its "Licensing" section: "Creative Commons
CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication" (the author waived all copyright: public domain). The
files are Commons' own 500 px thumbnails of the originals, committed unchanged. The SHA-256 values
are those of the committed files.
